matrix.existing: Canonical State Model mutation envelope requires expected_state_version and expected_state_digest; Lifecycle and Runtime V2 also bind exact parent version/digest.
matrix.decision: Reuse these exact-current preconditions as the concurrency authority for Version/Rollback.

matrix.existing: Lifecycle Transition Engine receipts preserve pre/post parent and ledger versions/digests plus rollback identities and return pre-transaction state on commit.
matrix.decision: Reuse receipt-style pre/post/rollback identity; Version/Rollback must not redefine lifecycle transitions.

matrix.existing: Runtime V2 already preserves immutable proposal snapshots, exact source/artifact/provenance identities, transactional receipts and append-only outbox entries.
matrix.decision: Reuse the append-only receipt/outbox pattern; Version/Rollback adds parent canonical-version lineage rather than a second proposal runtime.

matrix.existing: MANUSCRIPT_MANIFEST carries version_id, artifact_digest, parent_version_ref and change_set_ref.
matrix.decision: Preserve these fields and bind them into the unified parent object-version ledger.

matrix.existing: GOVERNING_BRIEF, CANON_MANIFEST, STORY_BIBLE and BOOK_PLAN already carry object IDs plus version fields.
matrix.decision: Do not replace their schemas merely to version them; create sidecar immutable object-version nodes binding exact payload digests and predecessor nodes.

matrix.gap: No single durable parent ledger currently reconstructs complete canonical-state snapshots, exact object-version nodes, active-version bindings and restore lineage across all governed Book objects.
matrix.decision: Add one Book-parent version ledger as an authority-preserving overlay on the qualified Canonical State Model.

matrix.gap: Some current active refs name object IDs without independently proving which version payload/digest is current when multiple versions share an ID.
matrix.decision: Version ledger records exact active binding node IDs for governing brief, canon manifest, story bible, plan and manuscript at each committed parent state.

matrix.gap: Existing receipts preserve rollback targets but no parent executable boundary currently restores prior accepted content while preserving later history and revalidating current authority.
matrix.decision: Implement restoration as a new successor state derived from an exact historical snapshot. Never edit or delete the historical target.

matrix.gap: Lifecycle invalidation covers dependent units after upstream change, but an aggregate content restore needs an explicit bridge back to current dependency/evidence revalidation.
matrix.decision: Any changed active binding requires explicit current dependency/evidence revalidation refs; lifecycle status changes remain delegated to qualified Lifecycle authority.

matrix.existing: Author decisions are explicit parent objects and Lifecycle gates verify APPROVED current decisions.
matrix.decision: Restore operations preserve current author-decision history and may reference existing approved decisions; they cannot create, rewrite or infer an author decision.

matrix.existing: Export releases and publication authorization are distinct parent evidence/authority boundaries; Runtime V2 cannot grant them.
matrix.decision: Restore preserves export/proof history but cannot reactivate prior export freeze/publication authority. A frozen/published project must be reopened through lifecycle authority before content restoration.
Do not build Git-like branching, merging, repository hosting or user-facing source-control semantics inside Book System. Only the bounded immutable Book version ledger is authorized.
Do not duplicate the existing parent state + ledgers with a general event-sourcing/CQRS platform.
Version/Rollback may require and record a qualified lifecycle receipt but must not independently authorize or reimplement project/unit lifecycle transitions.

net_new_executable_scope: immutable complete-state snapshot nodes with predecessor lineage
immutable governed-object version nodes with exact digests/predecessor lineage
exact active-version binding per state snapshot
successor commit with exact-current concurrency and idempotent request handling
restore prior content as a new successor after current dependency/rights/privacy/author checks
append-only version/restore receipts and outbox entries
preserved_external_authorities: Canonical State Model remains the parent aggregate contract.
Lifecycle Transition Engine remains lifecycle-status authority.
Runtime V2 remains provider intake/admission authority.
Author Decision Queue successor will own decision collection/workflow; Version/Rollback cannot fabricate decisions.
Document mechanics remain outside Book System.
exact_next_action: Define and implement BOOK-SYSTEM-VERSION-AND-ROLLBACK-001 as the bounded parent version-ledger/restore overlay described by this map and the preimplementation research checkpoint.
qualification_effect: NONE. This forensic map is architecture evidence only and transfers no existing exact-SHA qualification to future Version/Rollback bytes.
